Sobre el grup de recerca

L’Institut d’Investigació Biomèdica de Bellvitge (IDIBELL) és un centre de recerca capdavanter situat a la zona sud de Barcelona. Integra l’activitat de recerca biomèdica de l’Hospital Universitari de Bellvitge (HUB), l’Institut Català d’Oncologia (ICO) i la Universitat de Barcelona (UB) al Campus de Bellvitge. Des de l’1 de gener de 2020, IDIBELL també ha integrat el Centre de Medicina Regenerativa de Barcelona (CMRB).

Les principals àrees de recerca d’IDIBELL inclouen el càncer, les neurociències, la medicina translacional i la medicina regenerativa. Amb un fort compromís amb la recerca, la innovació i l’impacte social, la missió d’IDIBELL és millorar la qualitat de vida de la ciutadania.

Com a centre CERCA de la Generalitat de Catalunya, IDIBELL s’ha consolidat com un referent nacional i internacional en recerca biomèdica. L’any 2009 va ser un dels cinc primers centres de recerca de l’Estat espanyol acreditats com a institut d’investigació sanitària per l’Institut de Salut Carlos III. Més recentment, la Comissió Europea ha atorgat a IDIBELL el distintiu HRS4R (Excellence in Human Resources in Research), en reconeixement al seu compromís amb la implementació de la Carta Europea de l’Investigador i el Codi de Conducta per a la Contractació i Gestió de Personal Investigador.

El compromís d’IDIBELL amb l’excel·lència en la gestió de persones reforça encara més la seva posició com a centre de prestigi en recerca biomèdica.

  • Donar suport i facilitar la coordinació de l’equip multidisciplinari en l’execució dels processos operatius.

The IDIBELL Communication and Fundraising Unit works to strengthen the institute’s institutional image, bring research closer to society and mobilise resources to support scientific activity.

Cognition and Brain Plasticity is an interdisciplinary Unit devoted to studying the nervous system’s structural and functional reorganization capacity, and its role in development, neurological injuries, learning, neurorehabilitation and/or interventional processes. We combine neuroimaging techniques with specific experimental paradigms in order to understand the mechanisms of plastic changes in the brain. This multidisciplinary goal can be seen in the research topics of the different groups in the unit, focusing on language learning and its dysfunctions, the dynamics of memory formation and reward processing, and motivation. Clinical Trials Study Coordinator - Nephrology and renal transplantation

REF. 26-161_SS_JC

About the research group

The Nephrology research group interest spans a broad area, ranging from immunology, renal replacement therapy, transplantation, chronic kidney disease including diabetic nephropathy, and regenerative medicine. Our research is mainly translational, collaborative and aimed to improve the care and health of patients with kidney diseases. Our ultimate goal is innovation in disease monitoring and therapy, gathering basic science with our clinical expertise, to move towards personalized medicine in Nephrology.

About the role

We are looking for a Clinical Trials Study Coordinator for the Nephrology and Renal Transplant research group, to conduct phase I to phase IV Clinical Trials.
The Study Coordinator ensures the smooth and efficient operational management of clinical research studies, facilitating collaboration among all stakeholders while maintaining high standards of data quality, participant safety, scientific integrity, and regulatory compliance.

Main Tasks and Responsibilities:
• Coordinate participant recruitment, screening, enrolment, and follow-up, including scheduling study visits and ensuring appropriate participant communication.
• Prepare, maintain, and update essential study documentation, including the Investigator Site File (ISF), informed consent forms, and study records.
• Collect, enter, review, and maintain clinical study data in electronic data capture (EDC) systems, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and traceability.
• Assist in addressing queries, protocol deviations, and corrective actions
• Support clinical monitoring visits and audits. • Ensure compliance with ICH-GCP guidelines, ethical and regulatory requirements
• Act as a liaison between the Principal Investigator, clinical research team, study sponsors, Contract Research Organizations (CROs), and other relevant stakeholders.
• Coordinate the availability and management of study materials, biological samples, investigational medicinal products, and equipment required for study activities.
• Assist in documenting and reporting adverse events, serious adverse events, protocol deviations, and other study-related issues in accordance with applicable procedures.
• Participate in meetings and activities with the Research Group to stay informed about study progress.

Job requirements

Professional experience

  • Previous experience as a Clinical trials Study Coordinator.

Education and training

  • Degree in Health or Experimental Sciences.
